Headline: Green Line Delays
ShortDescription: Some Green Line trains are running with residual delays after earlier signal problems at Cottage Grove. Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Some Green Line trains are running with residual delays after earlier signal problems at Garfield.

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

Shuttle buses are available between Garfield and Cottage Grove to provide connecting service through the affected area on both directions.

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.
